# function: time_condition

Returns a `time` condition, for use in `conditions`. It has no required arguments: `options` must set `after`, `before`, `weekday`, or several of them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A time condition has no required arguments; options must set after, before, or weekday.
locals {
  # Same as { condition = "time", after = "22:00:00", before = "06:00:00" }
  night = provider::homeassistant::time_condition({ after = "22:00:00", before = "06:00:00" })
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
time_condition(options dynamic...) dynamic
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->

<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Dynamic) At most one object of further keys to set on the result, e.g. `{ name = "Kitchen" }`. Keys with a null value are left out. It must not set a key that another argument already sets.
